description: Pre-approved Meta WhatsApp Business message templates. These are used when outside the 24h conversational window.

en.body: Hi {{1}}! Thanks for reaching out. Our team is currently offline. Business hours are Mon-Fri 8AM-8PM, Sat 9AM-5PM, Sun 10AM-2PM (Sri Lanka time). We'll get back to you as soon as we're back! 🕐
